name: Ferrogate Transit Security Bike
description: A light electric motorcycle used by Ferrogate transit security for patrol and rapid response along rail lines, bus routes, and transit hubs. Faster than walking, smaller than a cruiser, and cheap enough to deploy in numbers. T-Bike riders are the most visible law enforcement presence in Tier 1-2 transit areas — for better or worse. Most are just trying to keep the L-train platforms safe. Some are on the take. The bike itself is unremarkable, functional, and bearing the Ferrogate blue-and-gray livery that everyone in GLMZ recognizes.
armament: Siren, lights, integrated comm system, stun baton mount.
common_usage: Transit line patrol, platform security, emergency response along routes.
story_hooks: A T-Bike officer discovers that their dispatch system has been routing them to avoid a specific platform at specific times — clearing it for something
Off-duty T-Bike officers moonlight as couriers using their security clearance to bypass checkpoints
physical_description: A compact electric motorcycle with a utilitarian frame of brushed steel and reinforced polymer, painted in faded Ferrogate blue with gray accents along the fairings. The seat is worn leather over a rigid chassis, and the handlebars are wrapped in grip tape darkened by years of rain and sweat. A sturdy light bar runs above the headlight, and the wheels bear the scuffs and grime of constant patrol across wet pavement.
